thread.title: Ford Gets A new Roadmap For Self-Driving, Literally, With RideOS Partnership

author: APARNA NARAYANAN
title: Ford Gets A new Roadmap For Self-Driving, Literally, With RideOS Partnership
text:
Ford Motor ( GM )-owned Autonomic will partner with startup rideOS, which develops routing software for self-driving cars, accelerating Ford's plan to launch a robotaxi service by 2021.
X RideOS discussed the pact in a news release touting $9 million raised in a funding round led by Sequoia Capital. Mapping and navigation experts who formerly worked for Uber and Apple ( AAPL ) lead the company, founded in 2017.
The cloud-based rideOS platform offers products and services that can be used as "building blocks" for on-demand autonomous services, the statement said. It enables autonomous vehicle routing, time of arrival estimates, dispatch, supply positioning, multi-rider trip planning and fleet management dashboards.
Ford bought transport services startups Autonomic and Transloc in January for undisclosed amounts as it plays catch-up in the self-driving race.
